about_the_game:
The second season is over. In the DLC “Twists of Fate,” we invite you to choose with whom to build a romantic relationship.

Four different storylines for every taste!

Maria: A college professor who wants to subjugate you

Mia: Your psychologist and friend who really wants to help you recover your memory

Bree: Your former boss. Maybe she still has feelings for you?

Rose: A modest library worker. But, as they say, still waters run deep...


Yes, YOUR FAVORITE CHARACTERS!
All four heroines are secondary characters. The most popular and hottest.


Add them to your wish list now! Release date: February 2026!
